title: NIHOMI.com Permanent System Architecture Blueprint & Engineering Constitution
objective: Establish the permanent, immutable System Architecture Blueprint and Engineering Constitution for NIHOMI.com, governing core stability, Modular Monolith & Hexagonal Architecture, AI Provider Abstraction (AI Fence), Offline-resilient PWA, and zero-compromise learning & evidence integrity.
in_scope: Audit existing codebase modules and map them to the 5 architectural layers.
Formulate the 4 Immutable Engineering Principles (Stable Core, Replaceable Adapters, Fail Safely, Evidence Before Release).
Define the Stable Core boundaries: Learning Journey, Progress & Evidence Ledger, Assessment & Spaced Repetition, Access & Entitlements.
Formalize the AI Fence: Decoupling AI models from curriculum authority, grading, and state mutation.
Specify the Ports & Adapters interfaces for AI, Database, File Storage, Payments, and External Services.
Define the Offline Resilience and Disaster Recovery architecture (PWA, Cache, IndexedDB/LocalStorage, Server crash survival).
Deliver executive blueprint artifact in Bengali.
out_of_scope: Breaking or modifying existing working runtime features.
acceptance_criteria: Comprehensive canonical document docs/NIHOMI_PERMANENT_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_BLUEPRINT.md created with complete layer mapping, Mermaid diagrams, and code references.
Strict AI Fence and Stable Core immutability explicitly defined.
TypeScript typecheck passes cleanly with zero errors.
verification: Architecture documentation contains explicit filepaths for every layer.
risks: Documentation divergence if future engineers bypass the architecture rules (mitigated by embedding rules into constitution and automated preflights).
